description:
Update the inventory record for 'Surgical Face Masks'. The logistics team has moved this stock to a new location and the price has changed.

Goal: Locate the item 'Surgical Face Masks' in the Inventory module and update the following details:
1. Change Location to: 'ER Supply Cabinet'
2. Change Price to: '15.50'

Do not create a new item; update the existing one. Save your changes.
